mcq.text: Which index is used for inflation targeting in India?
mcq.explanation: The target is set on headline CPI (Combined).

mcq.text: Which of the following can cause cost-push inflation?
mcq.explanation:
Cost-push inflation comes from higher costs of production.
Cause | Type
Oil price rise | Cost-push
Money supply growth | Demand-pull
